svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 82 x 80 mm blanks of 3 mm plate; break the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6.5 mm holes, measured from the front edge and up from the bottom:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 from the front, 15 and 40 up (shank bolts);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 7 from the rear edge, 65 up (rear spacer).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4 mm holes 3 mm below the top edge, 45 and 60 from the front,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the cable tie that holds the drop tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one each side of the shank's lower end, front edges 4 mm behind

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the shank front; a 12 mm spacer and M6 bolt at the rear keep them

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm apart. Seed falls between them into the furrow.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bottom edges are level with the shank bottom.
